scope: Read-only same-investigation source review plus harmless authored process controls. No cohort main or observe_window invocation, model inference, empirical predictions, annotation content, or repository edits by this reviewer. This is not independent science.

authored_controls.process_scope: Actual harmless subprocesses including an independent-session child. Deliberate child-discovery failures were cleaned up using fixture-owned PIDs by the test harness; no processes intentionally left running.

resolved_finding.issue: An exception while discovering direct children could previously skip owned process-group termination.
resolved_finding.resolution: Finally path always attempts owned group kill/wait, retaining discovery uncertainty separately without changing successful outer receipt schema.

resource_arithmetic.interpretation: A previous passing sample window cannot reserve shared APFS capacity. The launcher must use its fresh twenty-sample gate and the frozen supervisor must separately admit and monitor each actual invocation. No capacity approval is asserted here.

launch_contract_checks: Exact three fixed image order; one attempt each; no retry on outer, runtime audit, or consumer failure.
600-second numerical guard, 660-second outer watchdog, 120-second runtime audit, 300-second consumer watchdog; unchanged original 3 GiB RSS.
Outer receipt exact keys including immediate worker log digest/bytes agree with resource_gate.
CHECK_EXECUTION exact fields and sandbox-prefixed command agree with matching input_gate.admit_resource.
Parent INPUT_QUALIFICATION retains 936 reconstructed tensor identities across three exact images and zero model forwards; this review reads the receipt and does not rerun reconstruction.
Freeze must bind the launcher, plan, exact source inputs, all three contracts, controls, runtime before census, source reconstruction and qualified code before first empirical attempt.
remaining_limits: Observed direct children only. If discovery fails, the independent-session child may survive outer group termination; the cleanup record explicitly does not establish complete descendant cleanup.
No guarantee against external SIGKILL, process creation races, hostile fully self-consistent observation fabrication, or shared-volume changes after sampling.

Twenty samples are successive observations with requested 0.5-second sleeps, not an exclusive filesystem reservation or hard real-time stability guarantee. The resource guard separately checks actual sample gaps.
No empirical result is admitted by a launcher zero exit alone; complete resource consumer admission and later matching constraints remain required.
